errors.text_span: Ос Y е обозначена като „НИРД като % от БВП“
errors.evidence: The phrase "НИРД като % от БВП" is the title of the chart, not the label for the Y-axis. The Y-axis itself is not labeled.
The blue line is a solid line and does not have any round markers.
The orange line is a solid line and does not have any round markers.
The description fails to mention the dotted lines that are present for both the EU and Bulgaria series, which appear to be trend lines.
